name: ipranges
description: 🔨 List all IP ranges from: Google (Cloud & GoogleBot), Bing (Bingbot), Amazon (AWS), Microsoft, Oracle (Cloud), GitHub, Facebook (Meta), OpenAI (GPTBot) and other with daily updates.
readme_summary: This repository provides daily updated lists of IP ranges for major cloud providers and internet services like Google, AWS, Microsoft, and OpenAI. It offers both raw IP lists and merged CIDR notations for IPv4 and IPv6, facilitating network management and security configurations.
key_features: Daily updated IP ranges for major providers (Google, AWS, Microsoft, OpenAI, etc.)
Provides both raw IPv4/IPv6 lists and merged CIDR notations
Includes lists for Google Cloud, GoogleBot, Bingbot, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle Cloud, GitHub, Meta, Twitter, DigitalOcean, and more
Lists are obtained from public sources and stored as downloadable .txt files
primary_use_case: To provide up-to-date IP address ranges for various major online services and cloud providers, enabling users to manage network access, security rules, and firewall configurations effectively.
cover_image_prompt: A digital librarian meticulously organizing a vast, interconnected library of glowing IP address blocks. The librarian is placing specific blocks (labeled 'Google', 'AWS', 'Microsoft') onto shelves, while a separate section shows these blocks being neatly consolidated into compact, efficient CIDR notations. Data streams representing daily updates flow into the library. Subtle holographic displays show network diagrams and security icons. The scene is set in a clean, futuristic data center with cool, ambient lighting. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with clear, defined elements and a professional, organized aesthetic, emphasizing the repository's role in consolidating and presenting essential network information.

name: certimate
description: An open-source and free self-hosted SSL certificates ACME tool, automates the full-cycle of issuance, deployment, renewal, and monitoring visually. 完全开源免费的自托管 SSL 证书 ACME 工具，申请、部署、续期、监控全流程自动化可视化，支持各大主流云厂商。
readme_summary: Certimate is an open-source, self-hosted ACME tool that automates the entire lifecycle of SSL certificate management, including issuance, deployment, renewal, and monitoring. It offers a visual interface and supports cross-platform compatibility with zero dependencies.
key_features: Automates full-cycle SSL certificate management (issuance, deployment, renewal, monitoring)
primary_use_case: Automating and visualizing the management of SSL certificates for self-hosted environments.
cover_image_prompt: A diligent gardener tending to a vibrant, glowing tree that represents an SSL certificate. The gardener is shown visually inspecting and pruning branches (issuance, renewal) and watering the roots (deployment, monitoring). Small, abstract digital particles representing ACME protocols flow around the gardener. The tree's leaves emit a soft, secure green light, symbolizing a healthy HTTPS connection. In the background, subtle UI elements resembling a dashboard are visible, with the name 'Certimate' subtly integrated into a garden sign. The scene is set in a clean, modern garden with soft, natural lighting. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear, friendly iconography and a focus on the metaphor of growth and security.

name: geowifi
description: Search WiFi geolocation data by BSSID and SSID on different public databases.
readme_summary: Geowifi is a Python tool designed to search for WiFi geolocation data using BSSID and SSID identifiers. It queries multiple public databases to retrieve location information associated with wireless networks.
key_features: Search WiFi geolocation data by BSSID and SSID
Supports multiple public databases (Wigle, Apple, Google, Milnikov, WifiDB, Combain, Freifunk Carte)
Configuration via `config.yaml` for API keys and settings
Output options for map visualization (HTML) and JSON format
primary_use_case: To find the geographical location of WiFi networks by querying various public online databases using their BSSID or SSID.
cover_image_prompt: A digital compass with a glowing needle pointing towards a stylized map of the world. The compass face is overlaid with faint BSSID and SSID identifiers, representing the search query. Streams of data flow from the compass towards different points on the map, symbolizing the retrieval of geolocation information from various public databases. Subtle UI elements showing network signals and location pins are integrated into the scene. The overall aesthetic is a clean, modern digital illustration with a focus on clarity and information flow, using a color palette of blues, greens, and whites.

name: MetaRadar
description: A tool for BLE environment monitoring. Find and track Bluetooth devices around, create custom filters, get notified when the BLE fingerprint you are looking for is around.
readme_summary: MetaRadar is an Android application designed for monitoring and analyzing Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) environments. It allows users to discover, track, and filter BLE devices, providing insights into their privacy-preserving capabilities and potential for tracking.
key_features: Scan, analyze and track Bluetooth devices around
Create flexible filters for the radar
Deep analysis of scanned BLE devices via GATT services
Define approximate distance to the device
Offline operation, no personal data or geolocation sharing
primary_use_case: Monitoring and analyzing the Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) environment to identify trackable devices and understand device privacy features.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized radar screen displaying various icons representing Bluetooth devices. Some icons are clearly marked with a 'privacy shield' indicating they are secure, while others are highlighted with a subtle 'tracking' aura. A central magnifying glass hovers over a specific device icon, zooming in to reveal its metadata and GATT services on a small, integrated display. The background is a soft, abstract representation of a digital environment with subtle glowing lines. The overall mood is informative and empowering, suggesting control and awareness. The style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a cool color palette (blues, greens, purples) and clear, readable icons.

name: cronmaster
description: Cronjob management UI with human readable syntax, live logging and log history for your cronjobs.
readme_summary: Cronmaster is a TypeScript-based web UI for managing cron jobs. It offers a user-friendly interface for creating, viewing, and deleting cron jobs and associated bash scripts, with features like live logging, log history, and system information display.
key_features: System Information display (uptime, memory, CPU, etc.)
Script Management (view, create, delete bash scripts)
Job Execution Logging with stdout, stderr, exit codes, and timestamps
Live Updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE) for job status and logs
Smart Job Execution (background with live updates or synchronous)
Quick presets for common cron schedules
primary_use_case: To provide a centralized, user-friendly web interface for managing and monitoring cron jobs and associated scripts, simplifying task scheduling and execution logging.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical clockmaker meticulously assembling intricate gears and springs that represent scheduled tasks. Each gear is labeled with a human-readable job name, and a small, glowing pipe extends from some gears, carrying streams of colorful data (logs) into a transparent display box. The clockmaker uses a magnifying glass to inspect a live feed on a small, integrated screen showing system vitals like CPU and memory usage. The overall scene is set in a cozy, well-lit workshop with subtle digital elements and the repository name 'Cronmaster' subtly etched onto a workbench. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a warm, inviting color palette and clear, distinct elements.

name: drip
description: Self-hosted tunneling solution to expose localhost securely - unlimited bandwidth, no third-party servers
readme_summary: Drip is a self-hosted tunneling solution written in Go that allows users to securely expose local services to the internet without relying on third-party servers. It offers unlimited bandwidth and requests, and emphasizes user control over data and infrastructure.
primary_use_case: Enabling developers to securely expose local development servers or services to the internet for testing, collaboration, or public access, while maintaining full control over their infrastructure and data.
cover_image_prompt: A lone, sturdy lighthouse standing on a rocky outcrop, its powerful beam cutting through a dark, stormy sea to illuminate a small, isolated island. The lighthouse represents the 'Drip' server, securely broadcasting a signal. The island represents a local development server. Small, glowing digital pathways, like invisible bridges, connect the lighthouse's beam to the island, symbolizing the secure tunnel. Subtle UI elements resembling a command line interface are visible at the base of the lighthouse, showing connection status and bandwidth. The overall mood is one of secure, reliable connection against external chaos, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clear, contrasting light and shadow.
